name: Wikipedia / MediaWiki REST API
rate_limits: 200 req/s with unique User-Agent header. New rate limiting system being deployed in 2026. HTTP 429 returned when exceeded.
notes: 6.8M+ English articles. Three API interfaces: REST API (rest.php/v1/), Wikimedia REST API (/api/rest_v1/), and Action API (/w/api.php). REST API is best for structured data retrieval. Action API provides the most comprehensive access. Must set a descriptive User-Agent header. Available for all Wikimedia projects (Wikipedia, Wiktionary, Wikiquote, etc.). No API key needed. Content is CC BY-SA licensed.
